title: Freemax Maxus 100W Kit with Maxluke Tank Metal Edition 5ml
description:
Freemax Maxus 100W Box Mod Kit with Maxluke Tank Metal Edition 5ml
The Fireluke 3 Tank Metal Edition is included.
The Fireluke 3 Tank Metal Edition is an improved version of the Fireluke 3 Tank Resin Edition, which is known for its soothing flavours, huge clouds, and coil durability all over the world. It is CRC certified and has a Child Resistant Top Fill Build.
The Maxus 100W 21700 Mod blends all of the latest features, including the proprietary SmartLoad system from Freemax, for the simplest and quickest battery loading on the market.
The Maxus 100W Package has everything you need for sub-ohm vaping, including brand new panel options, and it’s the only single battery kit you’ll ever need.
Main Features:
Freemax FM Chip-MAXUS 1.0 Chipset
Dimensions – 90.2mm by 37.5mm by 28mm
Single High-Amp 20700 / 21700 Battery – Not Included
SmartLoad Technology – Load At Will
Wattage Output Range: 5-100W
Voltage Output Range: 0.7-7.5V
Resistance Range: 0.1-3.0ohm
Temperature Range: 100-315°C / 200-600°F
Nickel, Titanium, and Stainless Steel Wire Compatibility
Power Mode
VPC Mode
Bypass Mode
TC Mode
TCR Mode
Zinc-Alloy Chassis Construction
Intuitive Firing Button
OLED Display Screen
Magnetic Battery Door
Two Adjustment Buttons
Low Resistance Range
10s Timeout Protection
Open Circuit Protection
High-Temp Protection
Low Voltage Protection
Short-Circuit Protection
Automatic Coil Test
Same/New Coil Selection
Type-C USB Port
Threaded 510 Connection
It Contains:
1pc Freemax Maxus 100W VW Mod
1pc Freemax Maxluke Tank (Freemax 904L X2 Mesh Coil 0.2ohm pre-installed)
1pc Extra Freemax 904L X1 Mesh Coil 0.15ohm
1pc Extra Glass Tube 5ml
1pc Extra O-ring
1pc Type-C USB Cable
1pc Warning Card
1pc Warranty Card
1pc User Manual
